photos.c: One feature of our Southern League appearances this year has been the faithful band of loyal supporters who have provided the Belgrave team with superb support. Here we see the main ringleaders getting ready for the fray. Yes, your quite right. There's the Couzens, the Pritchards and who's that under the hedge? Quite right it's Bon Viveur and Carshalton Playboy -Ian Richley. But, have you spotted the two Coaches. Yes, the're there-Mick Dunphy and John Sullivan.....So how about a caption for this fine photo -?? The best versions will be printed in the next issue of the BELGRAVIAN.
